evidence.paraphrase: Dual LoRA adapters retain continual visual and textual edits.
Sequential optimization writes edits into LoRA adapters. For MemEIC, this specifically supports a fixed operational optimization objective of dual visual and textual evidence.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 7): During inference, the operative memory component (dual visual and textual evidence) changes through a fixed operational optimization objective; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
